The '''Exodeen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. A [[Battle of the Exodeen system (Mandalorian Wars)|battle]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] was fought here in [[3962 BBY]] as part of [[Mandalorian Triumph]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exodeen/Legends|Exodeen]], homeworld of the [[Exodeenian]]s.
